title: Ideogram
why: Image model strongest at legible text in images (posters, logos, hero type); free tier with daily credits.

title: Relume
why: AI sitemap and wireframe builder on a 1,000+ section library that exports to Figma, Webflow and React: a reference for marketing-site section patterns.

title: Hugging Face Spaces
why: Runnable demos of open image, video and 3D models (Hunyuan3D, Qwen-Image, splats) to try before installing.

title: Gemini image (Nano Banana)
why: Google's image generation and editing model (Nano Banana); strong at consistent edits of a reference image.
